run_model_training: run the training script with a config file path to start model training
resume_training_from_checkpoint: resume training from an auto-detected or specified checkpoint path using the --resume flag
enable_amp_training: enable automatic mixed precision training by passing the --amp flag to the training script
override_config_options: override config settings at runtime using --cfg-options with key=value pairs
configure_distributed_training: configure distributed training by specifying a launcher such as pytorch slurm or mpi
